data.title: Google unveils new cloud-based AI agent to compete with Meta, OpenAI
data.description: Top AI companies are reportedly preparing for a potentially catastrophic AI incident in 2027, with executives warning that rogue models or malicious actors could disrupt financial services, internet connectivity and critical infrastructure. OpenAI told Fox Business that its preparedness exercises explore potential scenarios, not inevitable outcomes. Meanwhile, European Union tech chief Henna Virkkunen defended the bloc's existing AI regulations as sufficient to address emerging threats.
